```yaml
name: Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
      checks: write
      actions: write
      packages: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Run release workflow
        uses: jmanhype/github-actions/.github/workflows/release.yml@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          release-type: git_ops
          path: .
          target-branch: main
          config-file: .github/git_ops.yml
```
